body: Please, provide a MRP or a reliable way to reproduce the issue, otherwise will be hard to find the cause of this bug.

> Please, provide a MRP or a reliable way to reproduce the issue, otherwise will be hard to find the cause of this bug.

**TL;DR:** Will try reproduce in my MRP tonight 👍

I had made one, but clearly it was was too simple... Cause it just worked right out off the gate...
Will try add more to it based on my own project. What I have noticed in my current MRP, is that the meshes that are created are skew, almost smeared along a strange axis. Will provide that MRP so long in case it's a related issue, and work on making the MRP have the same issue as I'm seeing in my main project. Will provide tonight, after work...

To give more context:

- I create multiple `MultiMeshInstance2D`'s, one per chunk essentially, at runtime. So no `MultiMeshInstance2D` exists until after you hit play. The `MultiMeshInstance2D`s all have the same size along with a similar mesh that's been moved, rotated, and scaled.
- The shader you see above sets the UV by the `custom_data` from a sprite atlas for selecting.
- After testing, I've noticed the error happens mainly when `SetInstanceColor` is used, though it can be intermittent and work for a single `MultiMeshInstance2D`, but even then it does not work for the other `MultiMeshInstance2D`s.
- The above artifacting you can see in the After screenshot, only occurs at specific angles/positions relative to the camera's position. Seeing as it's duplicating the instances and placing them on top of the previous render/draw calls, makes me think it might be misconstruing one instance for another?

Update:

Found that the one instance of `MultiMeshInstance2D` is being taken over by another somehow..?

_i.e._ If I toggle the visibility of the instance that's breaking, the broken instance seems to use the translation, color and custom_data from the instance next to it...

Still can't reproduce it in the MRP, but I've managed to fix it.

Seems to have been due to this change (somehow):
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/107666

Managed to fix it by adding:
```cs
this.PhysicsInterpolationMode = PhysicsInterpolationModeEnum.Off;
```

That's all...
